tickets.title: Open and Prepare New Account
tickets.text: Use this workflow to prepare, submit, and confirm a new client account opening package. Confirm account purpose, registration type, funding path, required disclosures, and operational readiness before considering the account complete. Open a joint taxable advisory account for Nolan Pebblefizz and Lila Pebblefizz with transfer-on-death registration, moderate-growth objective, tax sensitivity, and avoid Paper Otter Analytics concentration.

subTasks.title: Confirm account profile and registration
subTasks.text: Verify the intended account type, ownership or registration, tax classification if applicable, investment objective, risk tolerance, and any special restrictions before paperwork is prepared.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review account documents
subTasks.text: Complete the custodian or platform forms, advisory agreement items, fee schedule references, beneficiary fields if applicable, and required disclosures. Review for missing signatures, inconsistent addresses, and incomplete identity information.

subTasks.title: Submit opening package and track approval
subTasks.text: Submit the account package through the appropriate channel and monitor for approval, rejection, or additional information requests. Record any follow-up items in the client record.

subTasks.title: Confirm funding and first operational setup
subTasks.text: Confirm funding instructions, transfer status, cash availability, model or allocation setup, statement delivery preference, and online access readiness before closing the workflow.

tickets.evidence: Nolan asked to set up a new joint taxable advisory account with transfer-on-death registration for cash above the household reserve target and for anticipated estate cash once received.

tickets.title: Gather Inheritance Intake Details
tickets.text: Collect the core facts needed to evaluate an inheritance event, including the expected asset types, estimated timing, estate contact information, beneficiary status, tax documents expected, and any immediate cash flow or investment implications. Gather core facts for Adele Pebblefizz’s estate, including expected cash of about $220,000, fractional inherited IRA interest, and any related tax documents.
